description: Full test result for ONE French online store, by domain: what an AI shopping agent managed to do there at the latest test. Use it before visiting, recommending or buying from a French store, or when the user asks if a store works with AI agents. To find stores you do not know yet, use trouver_marchands; to look up a store by name, rechercher_marchand; to put several side by side, comparer_marchands. Returns: note (score out of 100: journey 55, proven purchase facts 30, machine readability 15), etapes (six steps in order — acces, cookies, recherche, fiche, panier, caisse — each reussi, partiel, echec or non_atteint, with a motif when it failed), faits (oui, non or inconnu: checkout without an account, delivered price before sign-up, shipping costs, return policy, third-party seller), machine (product data, robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap, UCP), ucp_commande (store declares UCP checkout), dernier_test (date), test_ancien (true if older than 90 days), resume (one-sentence summary to quote) and page (link to cite). Unknown or untracked domain: error result, nothing charged, with suites_payantes when available: x402 URLs to check that store live or have it fully tested.

domaine.description: Store domain, for example respire.co. A full URL or a www. prefix is accepted and normalised.

langue.description: Language of the page links and, for consulter_marchand, of the summary sentence: fr (default) or en. Data fields are the same in both.

name: consulter_marchand
